title: FS .docx will not convert: 'Could not find the body element: are you sure this is a docx file?'
msgKeys: Could not find the body element
symptom: office_to_md.py: '[ERROR] … file is an OLE container, not a docx zip' (mammoth: 'Could not find the body element: are you sure this is a docx file?').
rootCause: The file is a legacy .doc renamed to .docx, or a password/IRM-protected Office file (Compound File Binary header d0 cf 11 e0).

solutions.label: Save As .docx in Word
solutions.body: Open in Word, remove protection if any, Save As .docx, convert again. Do not fall back to MarkItDown.

prevention: Ask for FS files as real .docx.
